_notes: Phase 2.5 request-body templates for POST /connect/sla-management/sla-policies/<slaId>/milestones/<milestoneId>/actions. Send EXACTLY ONE action sub-object per call. timeLength/timeUnit live INSIDE checkpoint. timeUnit is Minutes|Hours|Days only. Never send isInitiationCheckpoint. Confirm success from body.success + non-empty body.actionMappings (+ triggerId for timed checkpoints), not the 201. UNIQUENESS: the actionFieldUpdate name/developerName must be unique per milestone (a WorkflowFieldUpdate DeveloperName is unique on the Incident object) — attaching the same-named action to a second milestone fails with DUPLICATE_DEVELOPER_NAME. Suffix both with the milestone (e.g. _FR for First Response, _RES for Resolution). These mirror the live-validated 'Proven bodies' in references/mcp-invocation.md (Milestone Actions) — keep the two in sync.

warningAction._notes: Warn BEFORE target. timeLength = round(targetMinutes * (1 - X/100)). 2-hr (120-min) milestone, warn at 75% -> 30 min before. Default action = Field Update setting Priority = High. Replace <MS> in name/developerName with a per-milestone suffix. For a custom-field target, put its 00N... CustomField id in columnEnumOrId (not the __c API name).

violationAction._notes: Escalate ON breach = Violation with timeLength 0 (fires at target). Default: set Priority = Critical. Replace <MS> in name/developerName with the same per-milestone suffix used for the warning.

istBusinessHours._notes: 'IST business hours' is a POLICY-level BusinessHours, not a milestone-action field. Resolve-then-create: reuse an existing BusinessHours with TimeZoneSidKey='Asia/Kolkata' if present, else POST /sobjects/BusinessHours with this body (confirm first; BusinessHours is NOT API-deletable). Attach via the policy/Entitlement BusinessHoursId. If the org has ignoreMilestoneBusinessHours=true, milestone timers run 24/7 and ignore this - disclose that.
istBusinessHours.Name: IST Business Hours
